sources.title: pytorch/Qwen3-32B-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model's quantization is powered by TorchAO, a framework presented in the paper TorchAO: PyTorch-Native Training-to-Serving Model Optimization. Abstract: We present TorchAO, a PyTorch-native model optimization framework leveraging quantization and sparsity to provide an end-to-end, training-to-serving workflow for AI models.

sources.title: Qwen3-32B-FP8: Open-Source Reasoning LLM with Thinking Mode ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3-32B-FP8 is a 32.8B-parameter open-source language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, available in FP8 (8-bit floating-point) quantized form. It supports both 'thinking mode' (for reasoning-heavy tasks like math and coding) and 'non-thinking mode' (for general conversation), switchable within a single model.
